name: Fotogenic AI – Product Image Generator for WooCommerce
author: fotogenicai

sections.description:
📸 Give your WooCommerce products a fresh new look

Your products. A fresh look. No new real photoshoot.

Turn the photos already in your WooCommerce store into studio shots, lifestyle scenes and on-model images for product pages, ads and social posts.

Fotogenic AI is an AI product photography plugin for WooCommerce stores and ecommerce businesses. Give a best-selling product a new look, prepare visuals for a launch, or refresh an entire collection, right inside WordPress.

Using SureCart, another ecommerce plugin or a regular WordPress site? Create new images from your WordPress Media Library, Posts and Pages, then use the saved results on your site. Direct product selection and automatic product updates are WooCommerce features.

  • Make your products the focus: create new looks for your WooCommerce product pages and galleries.
  • Prepare your next promotion: create campaign images for new arrivals, seasonal offers and social posts.
  • Refresh more of your catalog: select products and variations and generate in bulk.
  • Put new images to work: update featured images and galleries directly, with review-first or automatic options.

🎬 See Fotogenic AI in action

Explore the Fotogenic AI platform. This plugin provides the image creation, campaign and upscaling workflows described here.

🛍️ Update WooCommerce product images and galleries

From a fresh product look to your WooCommerce product page. Create, review and apply images in the same workflow, without downloading and uploading them again.

Choose how you want to work:

  1. Review images first: save the results, inspect them and apply the images you want.
  2. Update my store automatically: choose your image updates during setup and let eligible completed results use those settings.

For supported product and variation results, you can:

  • Replace the featured image with a new product photo.
  • Add images to the gallery at the beginning or end.
  • Replace the current gallery with your new images.
  • Keep results in the Media Library by choosing Review images first.

Your original files stay in the Media Library. Incomplete results may require review. AI creates new images, so check product shape, colors, logos and text before publishing.

📦 Bulk AI product image generation for WooCommerce

A new collection. A seasonal refresh. A catalog that needs a new look. Select the products you want to work on and create images together, without setting up a separate run for every item.

  • Find the right products: search by name, SKU or ID, and filter by category or stock status.
  • Select products and variations: apply a shared setup to the items you choose.
  • Check the estimate first: see the estimated credit cost before starting.
  • Follow your progress: larger product selections use background processing.
  • Return through History: reopen saved runs and review their results.

AI campaign images for launches, ads and social media

One product. More ways to promote it. Use Campaign Set to create a group of images with a shared creative direction for your store’s next launch or promotion.

  • 2 to 6 related images: build a set for new arrivals, a seasonal offer or a social campaign.
  • Creative options: choose the available style, model and output settings.
  • Single or multiple selections: create campaign sets from WooCommerce products or Media Library images.

🎨 AI product backgrounds and lifestyle photography

A plain product photo is just the starting point. Take a jacket outdoors, give a skincare bottle a colorful studio backdrop, or place home decor in a lifestyle setting.

  • New backgrounds and styles: explore clean catalog looks, colorful settings and lifestyle scenes.
  • Your existing photos: use the featured image, gallery photos or both as references.
  • Your creative direction: choose available environment and style settings, then add your own instructions.

AI models for product and fashion photography

Show clothing on a model, explore a different look, or keep the focus on the product alone.

  • Fotogenic AI models: choose from the available model library.
  • Your own references: select an available account reference or upload a model photo.
  • Reusable saved models: pick references saved in the plugin without finding them again in the Media Library.
  • Product-only images: create a scene without including a model.

✨ Product photography templates and custom controls

Start with a look you like. Make it work for your products.

  • Ready-made templates: browse by product category, preview the example and apply its creative and output settings.
  • Custom lighting and camera settings: guide the lighting, angle, framing and composition in custom image setup.
  • Image quality and aspect ratio: choose the available output options for your workflow.
  • Reference images and instructions: give the AI more direction about the result you want.
  • Saved setups: reuse a creative direction across your next collection or product selection.
  • Fotogenic Visual Intelligence: get suggested settings from your source image, then review and adjust them.

Template options are defined by each template. Switch to custom settings when you want more control.

AI image upscaling for existing product photos

Already have a product photo you like? Use Increase Resolution to create a higher-resolution version for your store.

  • Upscale product or Media Library images individually or in multiple selections.
  • Save the enhanced image as a new file in your WordPress Media Library.
  • Keep your original photo available for future use.

Get your new product look in 4 steps

  1. Choose your products: select WooCommerce products or variations from your catalog.
  2. Choose your look: start with a template or set your own creative direction.
  3. Check and generate: review the setup and estimated credit cost.
  4. Use your new images: review and apply the results, or use the automatic updates you selected.

More image tools for your WordPress content

Create beyond your product catalog, too. Use images for your blog, landing pages and other WordPress content. WooCommerce is optional for these workflows:

  • Generate Images with Media Library, Post and Page images.
  • Campaign Set and Increase Resolution with Media Library selections.

The plugin works in your WordPress dashboard and adds no frontend blocks, shortcodes, widgets or tracking scripts to your storefront.

Give your first WooCommerce product a new look

Start with a product you already sell. See what a new look can do for it. Install Fotogenic AI, connect your account and select a product photo from your store.

  • Free to install: image creation uses the Fotogenic AI service and account credits.
  • Free credits for eligible new accounts: try the service with no credit card.
  • Costs visible before you start: check your balance and the estimated generation cost in Studio.

View plans and pricing | Explore Fotogenic AI for WooCommerce

External Service

Fotogenic AI connects to the Fotogenic AI service when you connect an account, refresh account-backed configuration or pricing, use Fotogenic Visual Intelligence, or start and monitor an image workflow. Depending on the action, the plugin sends the selected image files, chosen recipe options, and the account/session data required to fulfill the request. Images returned by completed workflows are saved as new attachments in your WordPress Media Library.

Review the Fotogenic AI Privacy Policy and current Pricing before using the service.

Pricing

To view current plans, credits, and pricing details, visit our Pricing page.

More Information

sections.installation:
1. Upload the fotogenic-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it through Plugins -> Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Fotogenic AI -> Settings.
  4. Log in to your Fotogenic AI account.
  5. Open Fotogenic AI -> Studio and choose your first workflow.
sections.faq:
Can I create new product photos from images already in my store?

Yes. Choose your WooCommerce products and use their featured images, gallery images or both as references. You can also select images from the WordPress Media Library.

Can I change a product photo’s background or show it on a model?

Yes. Generate new images using available style, environment and model options, or start with a template. You can add your own references and instructions. This creates a new image rather than editing only the background, so check that the result accurately represents your product.

Can I generate product images in bulk?

Yes. Generate Images supports one or multiple Products, Media Library items, Posts or Pages. Campaign Set and Increase Resolution support one or multiple Products or Media Library items. Larger product selections are processed as a managed queue.

What is the difference between Generate Images, Campaign Set and Increase Resolution?

  • Generate Images: create a new look for your product.
  • Campaign Set: create 2 to 6 related images with a shared creative direction.
  • Increase Resolution: create a higher-resolution version of an existing image.

Can I save and reuse my product photography settings?

Yes. Save your creative setup and use it again for another selection. You can also reuse model references saved in the plugin.

Will my WooCommerce product images change automatically?

Only if you choose automatic updates during setup. Select Review images first to save results without changing your products, then apply the images you want after reviewing them.

Can I replace a product image or add images to its gallery?

Yes. For eligible product results, replace the featured image, add images at the beginning or end of the gallery, or replace the gallery. You can also keep results in the Media Library without updating the product.

Are my original photos deleted or overwritten?

No. Your original files are preserved. Generated and enhanced images are saved as new Media Library attachments. Changing which image appears on a product does not delete its original file.

Do I need WooCommerce?

WooCommerce 9.4 or newer is required to work with WooCommerce products and update their images. Without WooCommerce, Generate Images supports Media Library, Post and Page images. Campaign Set and Increase Resolution also work with Media Library images.

Is Fotogenic AI free, and do I need an account?

The plugin is free to install. A connected Fotogenic AI account is required to create images. Eligible new accounts can try the service with free credits and no credit card. Your account shows the current allowance; continued use depends on available credits or service access. See the current plans and pricing.

Can I see the cost before generating images?

Yes. Studio shows an estimated credit cost before you start. Check the estimate for your selected workflow, image count and quality.

Does this plugin add anything to my storefront?

No. Fotogenic AI runs in wp-admin and does not add frontend blocks, shortcodes, widgets or tracking scripts.
sections.changelog:
1.1.4

  • Expanded Generate Images, Campaign Set and Increase Resolution to support Products, Media Library images, Posts and Pages.
  • Added individual and bulk retries for failed images, plus regeneration of incomplete Campaign Sets while keeping previously saved images.
  • Added background processing for larger Media Library selections, with progress, pause, resume and recovery from History.
  • Updated Generate Images templates for the latest catalog, with supported model choices, optional environments and editable output settings.
  • Improved catalog reloads with cached pages, targeted preloading, matching skeleton placeholders and automatic loading as you scroll.
  • Restored Template and Style browsing before sign-in with shipped previews, and matched Dashboard Style scrolling to Templates.
  • Improved automatic recovery from expired request tokens, outdated settings and temporary connection failures, with bounded retries and clearer error messages.
  • Reduced duplicate status requests and prevented ongoing generation from using up image download retries.
  • Made Dashboard the default entry point, added a shortcut on the Plugins page and corrected History navigation and WordPress menu highlighting.
  • Fixed Recent activity refreshes and empty states after account changes.
  • Simplified Results settings and image actions, with confirmation progress inside the popup and keyboard navigation between generated images.
  • Fixed keyboard focus after cancelling image deletion.
  • Fixed selecting variations unexpectedly clearing product selections.
  • Unified welcome, credit and error popups, with smoother timing and clearer balance and refund information.
  • Improved Media Library selection and saved-reference filtering, preserving cards and focus during loading and cleaning up references to removed source images.
  • Fixed template setup redraws and Model visibility flashes, preserving the preview, settings, focus and scroll when changing references.
  • Refined desktop, tablet and mobile layouts, including compact Model cards, smaller variation filters, visible Continue controls, overlay scrolling and aligned Summary actions.
  • Added update notifications with release notes, one-click updating and automatic reload after the update is confirmed.
  • Updated header and footer branding and simplified navigation.
  • Removed unused bundled artwork and outdated catalog data to reduce the plugin’s installed size.

1.1.3

  • Added optional automatic updates for WooCommerce product and variation images after generation.
  • Added gallery placement controls: add new images at the beginning or end, or replace the current gallery.
  • Simplified image setup and review, with clearer validation and image-count guidance.
  • Added style, model and image-quality choices for Campaign Set.
  • Improved template and environment browsing with progressive loading and smoother scrolling.
  • Made saved model references available in model pickers, with clearer names and separate tabs for Fotogenic models, account models and your saved references.
  • Improved History loading, navigation and retained-run recovery.
  • Improved credit estimates, confirmed charge and refund details, and low-credit messages.
  • Clarified successful, failed and partially completed results. Failed runs now offer Start a new run.
  • Fixed full-size image links and Increase Resolution for individual products.
  • Fixed rapid navigation in WebKit and improved popup focus, scrolling and page navigation.
  • Refined layouts and action bars across phone, tablet, desktop and large screens.

1.1.2

  • Added a Home screen with style inspiration, templates, workflow shortcuts and recent creations.
  • Added Fotogenic templates, models and environment references to supported generation workflows.
  • Expanded background processing for large Product selections in Generate Images and Campaign Set.
  • Added batch Increase Resolution for Product images and whole Media Library selections while preserving originals.
  • Improved Configure and Generate navigation, source selection, status sorting and credit estimates.
  • Added welcome and first-result guidance, low-credit alerts and insufficient-credit prompts, with balance checks before generation.
  • Improved live progress, pause, stop and resume behavior while keeping completed results accessible.
  • Fixed Run History entries, pagination, result recovery and conflicting Product gallery updates.
  • Improved template caching, account reconnection and loading/error handling.
  • Refined desktop, tablet and mobile layouts with more compact rows, consistent controls and smoother updates.

1.1.1

  • Redesigned the Studio with a guided four-step workflow for selecting sources, configuring images, generating results, and reviewing them.
  • Added multi-item generation for WooCommerce Products, Media Library images, Posts, and Pages.
  • Added Campaign Set for creating coordinated groups of campaign images.
  • Added Increase Resolution for creating enhanced images without overwriting original images.
  • Added category and stock filtering, desktop infinite scrolling, and queued processing for larger Product catalogs.
  • Added live progress, pause, resume, stop, run history, and recovery controls.
  • Improved result selection and Product gallery, featured-image, and Media Library actions.
  • Improved login, logout, signed-out behavior, credit estimates, loading states, and error handling.
  • Improved desktop, tablet, and mobile layouts throughout the Studio.
  • Fixed compatibility when updating from older active plugin versions.
  • Added compatibility with WordPress 7.1 and PHP 7.4 through 8.5.
  • WooCommerce remains optional for Media Library, Post, and Page workflows.

1.0.8

  • Compatibility with WordPress 7.0.

1.0.7

  • Maintenance release with minor plugin documentation improvements.

1.0.6

  • Fixed WooCommerce product gallery updates after generated images are added or removed from Studio.
  • Improved product cache refresh behavior so gallery and featured-image changes appear without extra page refreshes.
  • Improved compatibility with WooCommerce product image gallery extensions.

1.0.5

  • Maintenance release with minor usability refinements.

1.0.4

  • Improved bulk progress state handling and simplified the settings auth popup experience.

1.0.3

  • Maintenance release with minor usability refinements.

1.0.2

  • Improved WordPress compatibility and overall admin experience.

1.0.1

  • Improved the Studio and Settings UI styling.
  • Fixed the Settings tab rendering regression.
  • Refined picker and bulk workflow behavior.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
